topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I examined the flowers, their vibrant colors a stark contrast to the sterile, predictable environment of my living room. They were beautiful, yes, but their presence was a puzzle, a silent envoy with no explanation. The vase stood empty of any note, any clue as to the sender’s identity or intent. Each petal seemed to whisper a question, a silent demand for answers I couldn’t provide. I moved closer, the scent a gentle pressure in the air, sweet yet unsettling. Part of me longed to unravel the mystery, while another part recoiled, preferring the comfort of the known, however dull. The telephone, usually a mundane object, now loomed large, a potential conduit for the unknown. I hesitated, my fingers hovering over the receiver, the weight of unanswered questions heavy in the silence.
